mapper.select: SELECT source.id AS data_source_id, source.knowledge_space_id, source.name AS display_name, source.status, source.version, source.failed_operation, publication.artifact_id AS published_artifact_id, publication.quality_status AS published_quality_status, publication.published_at FROM knowledge_data.governed_data_source source LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT current_publication.artifact_id, current_publication.quality_status, current_publication.published_at FROM knowledge_data.published_sync_artifact current_publication WHERE current_publication.tenant_id = source.tenant_id AND current_publication.knowledge_space_id = source.knowledge_space_id AND current_publication.data_source_id = source.id ORDER BY current_publication.source_version DESC LIMIT 1 ) publication ON TRUE WHERE source.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND source.knowledge_space_id = #{knowledgeSpaceId} AND source.source_type = 'FILE' ORDER BY source.created_at DESC, source.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
